name: Boolean shape operations
description: Adds shape operations to the vector costume editor: Unite, Subtract, Intersect, Combine/Release, and Expand.

info.text: "Unite" merges all selected shapes into one filled shape.
"Subtract" uses the front shape to cut a hole through every selected shape below it. Hold Shift to cut only the back shape, or Alt (Option on macOS) to keep the cutter.
"Intersect" keeps only the areas where the selected shapes overlap. Hold Alt (Option on macOS) to divide them into separate regions.
"Combine" joins selected shapes into a compound path, making overlapping areas transparent. "Release" splits a compound path back into separate shapes.
"Expand" grows each selected shape outward by half its outline width, moving the fill edge to where the outer edge of the outline was.
In Reshape mode, "Open Shape" splits a closed shape into an outline at the selected point, and "Close Shape" joins an open outline's ends back into a shape.
The shape operation buttons may move into the "More" menu on smaller screens.
